title: Context, consistency and consumers: How to battle misinformation in beauty
summary: Communicating science to beauty consumers remains a challenge, but providing context, being consistent and meeting audiences where they are is key to success, say industry execs. Speaking during a panel session at the UK's Cosmetic, Toiletry and Perfumery Association's (CTPA) inaugural scientific conference earlier this month, members of government and industry came together to discuss strategies for public, media and consumer engagement in beauty.
